'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Kingery LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: It's my Deck.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
